title: Canonical 855 (PO Acknowledgment) — business document, direction-NEUTRAL
description: Acknowledgment of a PO. Direction is a relationship property: product OUTPUT when the client RECEIVES an 855 (buyer role), product INPUT when the client SENDS an 855 (supplier role acking a received 850). `_meta` is populated only on inbound (receive). Supersedes the old 855.inbound shape (D9 revised) — source/unmapped moved to the shared inboundMeta.

status.description: Overall acknowledgment (BAK01): AC=accepted, AD=ack w/ detail, RD/RJ/RF=rejected variants.
Line ack code: IA=accepted, IR=rejected, IB=backordered, IC=changed.

_meta.description: Populated ONLY when this 855 was RECEIVED (buyer role).
